reached_sql:
WITH store_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE s_store_name = 'ese'
),
time_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT t_time_sk
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE t_hour = 8 AND t_minute >= 30
),
household_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_dep_count = 0
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM store_sales ss
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store_keys sk WHERE ss.ss_store_sk = sk.s_store_sk)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM time_keys tk WHERE ss.ss_sold_time_sk = tk.t_time_sk)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM household_keys hk WHERE ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hk.hd_demo_sk)
ORDER BY count(*)
LIMIT 100
